title: Database Leaderboards
description: Make placeholders of leaderboards or data of each player from any plugin connected to MySQL.
body:
![Plugin logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ab0efebf9f3e93325aace9ce65d01ee3f57843d8.png)

Make placeholders in seconds with a chat-gui or manually with the config.yml




Main command: /DBL (dbleaderboards.admin)


Leaderboards placeholders %dbl_top_[topname]_[0-10]_name%
%dbl_top_[topname]_[0-10]_value%
Data: contains player info, kills, balance, name, prefix %dbl_data_[dataname]%
Static: server info, not contains player info %dbl_static_[staticname]%
